say:0:1013107001:0.text: You there! We have the best metal oil for your gorgeous helmet!
say:0:1013107001:0.source_cn: 这位骑士大哥，您头顶的翼冠实在亮眼！我们这有最好的金属...

say:1:1013107002:0.text: Good eye! Give me three bottles! Wait...
say:1:1013107002:0.source_cn: 眼光不错嘛，给我来三瓶——啊，好像多了点，就先来两瓶吧……

say:2:1013107003:0.text: These guys seem different from the Syndicate people from before.
say:2:1013107003:0.source_cn: 这些黑金商人和我们见过的那些黑金坏蛋，好像不太一样……

say:3:1013107004:0.text: Well, merchants are profit driven. Let's investigate more.
say:3:1013107004:0.source_cn: 商人是逐利之人，以利诱之就有道理可讲。在此处调查一番吧。
say:3:1013107004:0.male: Well, merchants are profit driven. Let's investigate more.
say:3:1013107004:0.female: Well, merchants are profit driven. Let's investigate more.
